findings.evidence: Some product pages use dynamic query parameters instead of clean, keyword-rich paths (e.g., /product?offer=xyz).
findings.impact: Lower crawlability and user memorability; weak signal for SEO.
findings.recommendation: Migrate to /products/[category]/[brand]-[model] pattern; 301 redirect legacy URLs.

findings.evidence: Product pages average <2 internal links pointing to them from content pages; no interlinking between related products (e.g., 3-tier cart ↔ storage bins).
findings.impact: Diluted page authority; missed cross-sell opportunities.
findings.recommendation: Add 2–3 context-aware internal links per product page in relevant blog/buying-guide content; create a 'related products' block.

findings.evidence: All 17 verified offers have title, meta description, H1, and disclosure in place per RIO policy.
findings.recommendation: Add schema.org Product and Offer structured data; include real-time price/availability (even if placeholder with 'check live' CTA).

findings.evidence: Disclosures appear only in footer; missing inline disclosure on product pages and before CTA buttons.
findings.impact: Platform policy risk (Amazon, Flipkart, etc.); erodes trust.
findings.recommendation: Add inline disclosure: 'As an affiliate, I earn from qualifying purchases' before each CTA; link to full disclosure page.

findings.evidence: No clear path from blog/buying-guide content to product page with pre-filled UTM; no A/B test for CTA copy or placement.
findings.recommendation: Add UTM builder tool; A/B test 3 CTA variants (e.g., 'Check Price', 'See on Amazon', 'Compare Prices') per product.

findings.evidence: Responsive layout confirmed via Chrome DevTools; no layout shift on scroll for verified offers.
findings.recommendation: Add tap-target sizing audit; ensure CTA buttons are ≥48×48px.

priority_fixes: Add inline affiliate disclosure on product pages
Add 2–3 internal links per product page in relevant content
Migrate product URLs to clean pattern and 301 redirect
next_steps: Draft disclosure policy update and implementation plan
Create internal linking checklist for content team
Add structured data template to site generator
Schedule URL migration and redirect mapping
next_task: After validator pass, commit changes, propose 2–3 immediate fix tasks, and rotate to next least-used pillar (2, 3, or 6).
